info.title: Excel Generator Connector
info.description: Create, edit, format, enhance, validate and analyze Excel workbooks.

post.description:
Builds a professionally formatted workbook and returns a download link.

IMPORTANT — every table block MUST have:
  - headers: a list of column name strings, e.g. ["Region", "Revenue"]
  - rows: a list of rows, each a list of cell values as strings, e.g. [["North", "1200"], ["South", "950"]]

A table block with only {"type":"table"} or {"type":"table","name":"x"} will always fail.

MINIMAL WORKING EXAMPLE:
{"sheets":[{"name":"Sales","blocks":[{"type":"title","text":"Sales Report"},{"type":"table","name":"Sales","headers":["Region","Revenue","Units"],"rows":[["North","1200","80"],["South","950","60"]],"columns":[{"header":"Revenue","format":"currency0","total":"sum"}],"totalRow":true},{"type":"chart","chartType":"column","title":"Revenue","data":{"table":"Sales","categories":"Region","series":["Revenue"]}}]}]}

fileName.description: Name for the workbook, without extension

theme.description: vkollab (blue, default), slate, green or orange

currency.description: USD, INR, EUR, GBP, JPY, AUD or CAD (used by currency formats)

sheets.description: List of sheet objects. EACH SHEET has: name (required) and blocks (list of block objects). EACH TABLE BLOCK needs: type='table', name (string), headers (list of column name strings), rows (list of rows; each row is a list of values as strings). Numbers like 1200 can be sent as the string '1200' and will be converted. Dates should be 'yyyy-mm-dd'. Formulas start with '='. DO NOT send a table block without headers and rows — it will always fail. Other block types: title (needs text), kpis (needs items), chart (needs chartType and data), text (needs text or lines), spacer (needs count).

post.summary: Edit, clean, format or enhance an Excel workbook
post.description: Opens an existing workbook (or CSV) and applies a list of operations. The original is never changed; a new file is returned.

fileUrl.description: Public direct-download link (private SharePoint/OneDrive links do not work)

fileName.description: Original file name including extension, e.g. budget.xlsx

source.description: The existing workbook. Give fileBase64 or fileUrl.

operations.description: Ordered list of edits (max 80). Each needs op and usually sheet. Examples: {"op":"enhance_sheet","sheet":"Orders"}; {"op":"clean_data","sheet":"Orders","actions":["trim","text_to_numbers","remove_blank_rows","dedupe"]}; {"op":"add_formula_column","sheet":"Orders","header":"Margin","formula":"=[@Profit]/[@Revenue]","format":"percent"}; {"op":"conditional_format","sheet":"Orders","column":"Status","rule":{"type":"status","map":{"Done":"green","Late":"red"}}}; {"op":"auto_dashboard","sheet":"Orders"}

get.description: Returns every operation, block, chart type, conditional-format type and number format.

value.description: A number as text, or a formula such as =SUM(Sales[Revenue]) (Table[Column] refers to a named table)

format.description: currency, currency0, integer, number, percent, percent0, date, thousands, millions

type.description: list, whole, decimal, date, textLength or custom

values.description: Allowed values for a list dropdown

source.description: Cell range for a list, e.g. =Lists!$A$1:$A$9

error.description: Message shown when the entry is rejected

prompt.description: Hint shown when the cell is selected

Validation.description: Cell rule applied to the whole column

type.description: colorScale, dataBar, iconSet, cell, text, formula, topN, bottomN, duplicates, blanks or status

palette.description: For colorScale: rag (red-yellow-green), gyr, blue or green

color.description: green, red, amber, blue, grey, orange or a hex colour

operator.description: For cell: greaterThan, lessThan, between, equal, notEqual ...

n.description: How many items for topN / bottomN

map.description: For status: word to colour, e.g. {"Done":"green","Late":"red"}

header.description: Exact header text this setting applies to

format.description: currency, currency0, integer, number, percent, percent0, date, datetime, month, text, thousands, millions

formula.description: Formula filled down the column, e.g. =[@Units]*[@Price] ([@Name] = same row, column named Name)

total.description: Total row aggregate: sum, avg, count, min or max

cf.description: Conditional formatting rules for this column

column.description: Source column header (not needed for count)

agg.description: sum, count, avg, min or max

table.description: Name of the table (or summary) that holds the data

series.description: Headers of the numeric columns to plot

ChartData.description: Where the chart gets its data

type.description: What to draw. table needs headers + rows. chart needs chartType + data. kpis needs items. title needs text.

name.description: Table/summary name used by charts and formulas (letters, digits, underscore)

text.description: Title text (type title) or paragraph (type text)

lines.description: Lines of text for type text

style.description: For text: normal, heading, note or bullets

rows.description: Table data rows: a list of rows, each a list of values as text. Numbers like 1200 are converted; dates as yyyy-mm-dd; formulas start with =

items.description: One row of cell values, same order as headers

columns.description: Optional per-column settings (format, formula, total, validation, conditional formats)

totalRow.description: Add a totals row (use with columns[].total)

excelTable.description: Make it a real Excel Table with filters

source.description: Summary: name of the source table

groupBy.description: Summary: header of the column to group by

values.description: Summary: what to calculate per group

percentOfTotal.description: Summary: add a % of total column

top.description: Summary: keep only the top N groups

chartType.description: column, bar, stackedColumn, stackedBar, percentStacked, line, area, pie, doughnut, scatter or combo

place.description: Chart position: below (default), right, or a cell like H5

lineSeries.description: For combo charts: series to draw as lines

Text block.text: All amounts in INR. Totals calculated automatically.

title.description: Banner title shown at the top of the sheet

blocks.description: Content in order, top to bottom. Use this for full control.

kpis.description: Shorthand: KPI cards shown under the banner

headers.description: Shorthand: column names of the sheet's main table

rows.description: Shorthand: data rows of the main table

items.description: One row of cell values, same order as headers

columns.description: Shorthand: per-column settings of the main table

tableName.description: Shorthand: name of the main table (default Data)

type.description: list, whole, decimal, date, textLength or custom

palette.description: For colorScale: rag (red-yellow-green), gyr, blue or green

color.description: green, red, amber, blue, grey, orange or a hex colour

values.description: Allowed values for a list dropdown

n.description: How many items for topN / bottomN

map.description: For status: word to colour, e.g. {"Done":"green","Late":"red"}

source.description: Cell range for a list, e.g. =Lists!$A$1:$A$9

prompt.description: Hint shown when the cell is selected

Rule.description: Rule settings: conditional format fields or validation fields, depending on the operation

column.description: Header of the column to check

type.description: number, integer, date, text, email or url

regex.description: Pattern the whole value must match

fixTypes.description: Convert text numbers/dates to real ones

op.description: Operation name. add_blocks, add_chart, add_comment, add_filter, add_formula_column, add_hyperlink, add_sheet, add_totals_row, auto_dashboard, autofit_columns, clean_data, clear_range, conditional_format, copy_sheet, data_validation, delete_columns, delete_rows, delete_sheet, document_properties, enhance_sheet, find_replace, format_range, freeze_panes, insert_columns, insert_rows, merge_cells, move_sheet, named_range, page_setup, protect_sheet, rename_sheet, set_cells, set_column_width, set_row_height, sheet_properties, sort_range, unmerge_cells, validate_data

sheet.description: Sheet name, exactly as in the file

range.description: Cell range such as A1:F40 (optional: the main data table is detected automatically)

hasHeader.description: Whether the range starts with a header row (default true)

table.description: Name of a table created earlier

column.description: A column header (conditional_format / data_validation on one column)

columns.description: Column headers to limit clean_data to

cells.description: set_cells: cell address to value, e.g. {"A1":"Title","B2":"=SUM(C2:C9)"}

at.description: Start cell (set_cells with values, add_blocks) or row number / column letter (insert/delete)

values.description: set_cells: grid of values starting at 'at'

items.description: One row of cell values, same order as headers

actions.description: clean_data: trim, collapse_spaces, text_to_numbers, text_to_dates, remove_blank_rows, dedupe, proper_case, upper_case, lower_case, fill_blanks

keys.description: clean_data dedupe: headers that define a duplicate

regex.description: Treat find as a regular expression

after.description: add_formula_column: insert after this column header

format.description: Number format: currency, currency0, integer, number, percent, date ...

widths.description: set_column_width: column letter to width, e.g. {"A":20}

cell.description: A single cell like A2 (freeze_panes, add_comment, add_hyperlink)

allowFormulas.description: sort_range: allow sorting a range that contains formulas

fill.description: Background colour: primary, dark, light, band or hex

categories.description: add_chart: header of the label column

chartType.description: add_chart: column, bar, line, area, pie, doughnut, scatter, stackedColumn, combo

place.description: add_chart position: right, below or a cell like H2

targetSheet.description: Sheet to put a chart or link target on

name.description: Name of a new sheet / named range / dashboard sheet

blocks.description: add_blocks / add_sheet: formatted content to add
